title: At 20, he lost his Disney Channel job. This year, Forbes put his earnings at $70 million.
caption:
At 20, he lost his Disney Channel job. This year, Forbes put his earnings at $70 million.

YouTube star, then boxer: six straight wins after his 2023 loss, including Mike Tyson in front of 108 million viewers.

Outside the ring: MVP (now merged with the PFL), Betr, W at Walmart, and a venture fund managing $180M+ with stakes in OpenAI, SpaceX and Anduril.

A broken jaw last December. A $100M fund six months later.

Still think he's just a YouTuber?
